answer: Draw a jury of five per submission. Slash any juror whose score diverges from the panel median by two or more once a recheck confirms it. Replay every submission hash against the ledger, and a repeat triggers a clawback of the earlier payout. The canyon between attack cost and honest cost has to stay wide. Ivory tokens that look clean still carry a grain a replay exposes. A grove of clones pays five jury bonds to earn one share.
